Category: Super Luxury
Fabrication: You gotta get past Smasher first, choomba (Cannot be Fabricated, must be gifted or scavenged).
Class: Iconic EQ Heavy Melee
Range: 4m/yds
Mods: Bladesmith (Sharpened)

If the target took a Critical Injury from this blade or from Nehan last Round, its next Critical Injury carries 10 more bonus damage (15 total) and returns 5 HP to the user. Before it has been drawn in a fight, the user may attempt a ROF 1 Fluid Strike, drawing and cutting in one motion: on a hit it deals 2d6 more (5d6), and 4s and 5s count as 6s for Critical Injuries. Fluid Strike works once per encounter. Wielding or openly carrying it gives +2 on Facedowns against anyone who knows whose sword it is, or +4 if they're Arasaka too.

Foundry notes:

  • Listed capacity is N/A; the sheet tracks 0.
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Super Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
